edits.new: 10. On approval the service calls the notice approve operation of the rwb-comms contract so the notice state becomes Approved for the 16:00 dispatch run (JOB-10, RWB-P6-E2021-APP); on refusal it calls the hold operation with reason REFUSED_BY_APPROVER and asks rwb-case for a task in the case owner's queue with the reason. The notice move writes its own decision record through the local decision-record library in the same transaction as the notice change, so the notice row, the outbox row and the record commit together; the record carries decision code D7.1, rule_id and rule_version, the notice and case IDs, the template code and version, the state from and to, the reason code where one applies, the approver and the approval entry reference (decision_log_id). The library relays it on the shared topic; the approval entry stays the entry of the approval, and the central ledger holds both (ADR-022).
